verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird's VC practice page says the firm advises across the venture ecosystem, including angel investors, equity and debt funds, corporate investors and funding platforms, as well as high-growth companies. It also claims work across equity, venture debt, fund formation and corporate venturing that makes it "intimately familiar with market deal terms," and the TwoVenture hub targets both start-ups and their investors. Missing for 10: independent corroboration (e.g. rankings or client testimonials) of investor-side representation, current deal-volume data (the only figure is from 2017), and published market-terms surveys or named fund or investor clients.
